verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents two official SDKs, but both are narrow in scope: a Payments React SDK for building card-based agentic checkouts, and a Credits Wallet Embed SDK limited to Enterprise customers for embedding wallet funding. The core token, charge and introspection APIs appear only as raw REST endpoints (API-key header) plus an MCP server. No published OpenAPI spec was found that could be used to generate clients. missing for 10: general-purpose official SDKs (e.g. Python/TypeScript) wrapping the token, charge and introspect APIs; language coverage and install/versioning docs; independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
